About Us - Simply Smooth Skin Therapy Skip to main content Simply Smooth Skin Therapy Menu Home page Services About Us Gallery Contact us About DAWN COOP, LICENSED ESTHETICIAN/INSTRUCTOR Simply Smooth is privately owned and operated by Dawn Coop. Dawn is a Licensed Esthetician. She has advanced certifications in Sugaring, Microdermabrasion and Chemical Peels. Her desire is to provide customized services at an affordable price, that are results oriented in a relaxing atmosphere. She provides a wide range of services that include Customized Facials, Microdermabrasion, Chemical Peels, and Hair Removal (temporary and permanent). Dawn believes that Sugaring, as opposed to waxing, is far more superior in results, which her clients agree, men and women alike. Simply Smooth is a Christian based company. Dawn entered the field of Esthetics as a way for the Lord to use her and her skills to serve and bless others. “Each one should use whatever gift he has received to serve others” (1Peter 4:10 NIV).
